subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• In 2020, Natalia Ramos and colleagues in Canada and Mexico studied the effect of temperature on desert lizards' success in capturing prey.
• They found as temperatures increased, the lizards needed more time to successfully catch their prey.
• When temperatures were cool (around 70°F), lizards caught prey in an average of 2 seconds.
• In moderate heat (around 85°F), lizards required approximately 8 seconds on average.
• In extreme heat (around 100°F), lizards needed about 15 seconds on average to catch prey.
prompt: The student wants to summarize the study. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: For a 2020 study, researchers from Canada and Mexico collected data on desert lizards' attempts to capture prey in different temperature conditions.
choices.B: Natalia Ramos's 2020 study of desert lizards' success in capturing prey showed that as temperatures increased, the lizards' hunting efficiency decreased.
choices.C: Natalia Ramos and her colleagues wanted to know the extent to which temperature affected desert lizards' success in capturing prey, so they conducted a study.
choices.D: Knowing that desert lizards often struggle to catch prey efficiently, Natalia Ramos studied the animals' hunting speed, which averaged about 15 seconds in some conditions.

explanation:
Choice B is the best answer. The sentence effectively summarizes the study, noting who conducted it, when it was conducted, and what its results showed: that desert lizards' hunting efficiency decreased as temperatures increased.

Why A is incorrect:

Choice A is incorrect. While the sentence presents the methodology of the study—that is, the approach taken by the researchers—it fails to summarize the study as a whole.
